title: Hollis Heating & Plumbing
brief: I run Hollis Heating & Plumbing in Saint Paul, Minnesota: me, four techs and my wife Dana on dispatch. I don't need a pretty website, I need the phone to ring. We do furnace and boiler repair and replacement, AC repair and installs, water heaters (tank and tankless), drain cleaning and general plumbing repairs. Service area: Saint Paul, Minneapolis, Roseville, Maplewood, Woodbury and West St. Paul. Phone (651) 555-0172, answered 24/7 for no-heat and burst-pipe emergencies; office hours Monday to Friday 7am–6pm, Saturday 8am–2pm. We sell a maintenance plan with two tune-ups a year and priority scheduling (price to confirm). Put the phone and service area at the top, explain every service in plain words, show how a visit works, and add a quote request form. The form isn't hooked up yet, so it can't promise a call back in five minutes. Our license number goes in as a placeholder. No financing rates, no fake reviews, star ratings or "Google Guaranteed" badges.
